name: CyberBrick Arm
description: Control a CyberBrick robotic arm over the radio (through the CyberBrick remote) or USB: turn the base (max 90 degrees left or right of centre), move the arm joints, and open or close the claw.

driverPath.description: Path to arm_serial.py. Default: ../src/arm_serial.py next to this plugin.

python.description: Python interpreter with pyserial installed. Default: the .venv next to arm_serial.py if there is one, otherwise python3.

port.description: Serial port to use: the CyberBrick remote's in radio mode, the arm's receiver otherwise, e.g. /dev/ttyACM0 or COM5. Default: auto-detect.

transport.description: How commands reach the arm. radio: through the paired CyberBrick remote; usb: the arm's own USB cable. Default auto: radio once 'arm_serial.py radio-install' was run.

timeoutSeconds.description: Longest time one arm command may take. Default: 90.
